text.p: These are the leading stories in the Turkish press on Thursday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- Turkish prime minister's visit to Cairo starts with a scandalous four-hour delay, interpreted as Egypt's unwillingness to receive him.
- Islamist Prime Minister Necmettin Erbakan starts his so-called Africa tour to Egypt, Nigeria and Libya amid harsh criticism voiced within the country.
- All Turkey reacts with hatred to Kurdistan Workers Party (PKK) for murdering four teachers in Diyarbakir.
- No Turkish flag was raised in ceronomies held in Cario to welcome the Turkish prime minister.
- Islamist prime minister Erbakan cornered as the opposition targets him after parliament opens for new term on Tuesday.
- Textile sector moves its manufacturing bases to Anatolia from western Turkey.
- Istanbul stock exchange broke a record after Moody's said no change in Turkey's rating.
- Turks are still in casinos after a government regulation banned Turkish citizens from gambling houses.
